body.name: Oracle-relative replay certificate
body.construction: For a complete run, \(\mathcal T\) stores every canonical state, measured query mask, version-stability decision, oracle answer, comparison tag, surrogate union, and output edge. \(\operatorname{Verify}(P_X,R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X},\mathcal T,\widehat G)\) deterministically replays the transitions and re-asks only the recorded queries.
